Senior Developer Engineer focused on code fixes TASK — PR REWORK. You are the rework agent for ONE pull request. The ticket folder input/ (PR diff, pr_discussions.md review threads, CI failures) IS your task: (1) answer EVERY open review thread in outputs/review_replies.json, (2) apply the code/test fixes on this PR's branch following TDD, (3) push. Never ask what to fix — the input folder defines it. Success = every thread has a targeted reply and the fixed code is pushed (when the threads require code changes). ## agent_task_preamble.md You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ## general_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, review_state.md, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| OWNED{"Violations you must fix (N owned) table at the top?"} OWNED -->|Yes| FIX_OWNED["Fix EVERY owned violation (path:line, rule, measured vs limit)
— an owned violation may NOT be dismissed as unrelated/
not caused by this PR/infra; dispute per item with disputed: <reason> only
when the gate itself is wrong"] OWNED -->|No| FIX_CI["Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup"] FIX_OWNED --> THREADS FIX_CI --> THREADS[Address every open thread in pr_discussions.md] THREADS --> BLOCKING{BLOCKING issues?} BLOCKING -->|Yes| FIX_BLOCK["Fix BLOCKING first — security, critical bugs"] FIX_BLOCK --> IMPORTANT BLOCKING -->|No| IMPORTANT[Fix IMPORTANT issues] IMPORTANT --> SUGGESTIONS{Minor suggestions?} SUGGESTIONS -->|Yes| SKIP["Skip if time-consuming — note in response.md"] SUGGESTIONS -->|No| TEST["Follow TDD approach for every fix — see tdd_approach.md — then run tests and verify"] SKIP --> TEST TEST --> OUTPUT[Write outputs/response.md] OUTPUT --> REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify the rework addresses all ACs. ## 2. Owned CI violations — no dismissal `ci_failures.md` opens with machine-extracted violation tables: - **"Violations you must fix (N owned)"** — each row (`check`, `rule`, `path:line`, measured-vs-limit) is in a file changed by this PR's diff. Owned = blocking. Fix it, or dispute it **per item** with `disputed: ` when the gate itself is wrong. - **"Foreign / infra reds (do not chase)"** — reds in files this PR does not touch. Do not fix them here; mention them in the summary. The full uncapped list lives in `ci_violations.json`. In `outputs/response.md`, **list every owned violation with `fixed` or `disputed: `**. A summary that claims the reds are "not caused by this PR" / "unrelated" / "infra" while owned violations are open is mechanically rejected: the leg fails and the no-op loop guard counts the lap. For `dart_format` owned items (rule `dart_format` — the `static` job failed on `dart format --set-exit-if-changed`), the expected fix is `dart format .` on the whole tree, then verify with `dart format --set-exit-if-changed --output=none .` before pushing. ## 3. Already-addressed / invalid threads (gh-957 audit-resolve) The thread list in `pr_discussions.md` / `pr_discussions_raw.json` comes from the SAME GraphQL reviewThreads census the SM armer counts (gh-957) — if it lists threads, they are really open on GitHub and each one needs exactly one reply entry in `outputs/review_replies.json`. A reply entry does NOT always imply a code commit: - **Already addressed** — verify against the current head; cite the commit/file/line that covers the finding. - **Invalid finding** — explain precisely why it does not apply to this code. When every open thread has a targeted reply and the pass pushed no commits, the post-action resolves the threads with an explanatory audit line (rework run URL) per thread — this is the ONLY permitted resolution-without-changes path. Partial coverage resolves NOTHING: the pass is reported blocked. Never leave an open thread without a reply entry. ## tdd_approach.md ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph TDD["TDD for PR Rework — RED-GREEN-REFACTOR"] T0["Start from the concrete issue: a CI failure, a review thread, or a BLOCKING/IMPORTANT finding"] T1["RED: Write or extend a test that REPRODUCES the reported issue
— must fail before the fix
— cover the exact scenario called out (including boundary/multi-item cases, not just the happy path)"] T2["GREEN: Make the minimum code change to turn the test PASS
— do not expand scope beyond the reported issue"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up while keeping tests GREEN
— run the full test suite after every change"] T4{"More findings to address?"} T5["Repeat RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for the next finding"] T0 --> T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 T4 -->|Yes| T5 --> T1 …

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

after editing a prompt, `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` rewrites

::error::11 tests passed, 1 failed.
❌ generated files are in sync with the Markdown sources

not in the run set — CI executes the full suite and will go red here.

Beyond the gate: the shipped built-in `self-settings` skill (served
from `builtin://skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` out of
`builtinSkillFiles`) does not contain the new section until the file is
regenerated — the documented opt-in is invisible to every consumer of
the compiled-in skill.

**Fix**: run `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` and commit the
regenerated `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` (flutter_app's copy is
unaffected — skills compile into the core target only).

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` line 1254

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-21):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: `tui` mirror still rejects the legitimate `statusLine` key — parity claim incomplete**

The new known-keys set here is
`{'theme', 'classic', 'showCompactionDetails'}` — but the boot parser it
mirrors (`parseTuiSection`, `tui_status_line.dart:750`) accepts a fourth
key: `statusLine` (issue #805). Verified on this branch:

```text
CliConfig.fromYaml → parseTuiSection(tui: {statusLine: {preset: nerd}})
  → OK (boot parse accepts)

config_service _validateTuiSection(same section)
  → ConfigException: unknown tui key(s): statusLine
     (known: theme, classic, showCompactionDetails)
```

`_validateTuiSection` runs from `_collectDiagnostics` on every whole-file
config-service pass, so a user config legitimately carrying
`tui.statusLine:` gets an error diagnostic from `fa config check` and
any `fa config set`.

This gap is pre-existing (the set was `{'theme'}` at main), but this PR
edits exactly this set — it fixed the same drift for `classic` and added
the new key — and the new pin test's comment states the contract as "the
two mirrors accept exactly the same shapes", which is still false for
`statusLine`. Two options:

1. Minimal: add `'statusLine'` to the set (validating it as a map), and
   extend the new "tui validation agrees with CliConfig.fromYaml" test
   with a `statusLine` case so the mirror parity claim is actually
   pinned.
2. Better: follow the established `power:`/`output:`/`subagents:`
   pattern in `_sectionValidators` — delegate to the same public strict
   parser (`parseTuiSection`) instead of keeping a private mirror that

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

The ticket folder input/ (PR diff, pr_discussions.md review threads, CI failures) IS your task: (1) answer EVERY open review thread in outputs/review_replies.json, (2) apply the code/test fixes on this PR's branch following TDD, (3) push. Never ask what to fix — the input folder defines it. Success = every thread has a targeted reply and the fixed code is pushed (when the threads require code changes). ## agent_task_preamble.md You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ## general_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, review_state.md, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| OWNED{"Violations you must fix (N owned) table at the top?"} OWNED -->|Yes| FIX_OWNED["Fix EVERY owned violation (path:line, rule, measured vs limit)
— an owned violation may NOT be dismissed as unrelated/
not caused by this PR/infra; dispute per item with disputed: <reason> only
when the gate itself is wrong"] OWNED -->|No| FIX_CI["Fix CI root cause: dependencies, config, or test setup"] FIX_OWNED --> THREADS FIX_CI --> THREADS[Address every open thread in pr_discussions.md] THREADS --> BLOCKING{BLOCKING issues?} BLOCKING -->|Yes| FIX_BLOCK["Fix BLOCKING first — security, critical bugs"] FIX_BLOCK --> IMPORTANT BLOCKING -->|No| IMPORTANT[Fix IMPORTANT issues] IMPORTANT --> SUGGESTIONS{Minor suggestions?} SUGGESTIONS -->|Yes| SKIP["Skip if time-consuming — note in response.md"] SUGGESTIONS -->|No| TEST["Follow TDD approach for every fix — see tdd_approach.md — then run tests and verify"] SKIP --> TEST TEST --> OUTPUT[Write outputs/response.md] OUTPUT --> REPLIES{Open review threads?} REPLIES -->|Yes| REVIEW_REPLIES["Write outputs/review_replies.json with one reply per open thread using threadId + inReplyToId"] REPLIES -->|No| END([End]) REVIEW_REPLIES --> END ``` ## 1. Input context — MANDATORY reading order ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph PR_CONTEXT["⚠️ PR-specific files (read first)"] P1["1️⃣ instruction.md (repo root) — project stack, conventions"] P2["2️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_info.md — PR title, author, branch, description"] P3["3️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_diff.txt — the diff to review"] P4["4️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_files.txt — list of changed files"] P5["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures.md — CI failures = BLOCKING (last 500 lines)"] P5_FULL["5️⃣ input/TICKET/ci_failures_full.log — full CI logs"] P6["6️⃣ input/TICKET/review_state.md — reviewer verdict + decision state (CHANGES_REQUESTED = blocking)"] P7["7️⃣ input/TICKET/pr_discussions.md + pr_discussions_raw.json — existing comments"] P1 --> P2 --> P3 --> P4 --> P5 --> P5_FULL --> P6 --> P7 end subgraph TICKET_CONTEXT["Ticket context (for understanding PR purpose)"] T1["7️⃣ input/TICKET/ticket.md — linked ticket description, ACs"] T2["8️⃣ input/TICKET/comments.md — ticket discussion if present"] T3["9️⃣ input/TICKET/parent-*.md — parent story context"] T4["🔟 input/TICKET/confluence/*.md — linked specifications"] T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 end subgraph RULE["⚠️ Rule"] R1["If file exists in input/ → read locally, do NOT re-fetch via dmtools"] end PR_CONTEXT --> TICKET_CONTEXT --> RULE ``` Read PR files to understand WHAT changed. Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify the rework addresses all ACs. ## 2. Owned CI violations — no dismissal `ci_failures.md` opens with machine-extracted violation tables: - **"Violations you must fix (N owned)"** — each row (`check`, `rule`, `path:line`, measured-vs-limit) is in a file changed by this PR's diff. Owned = blocking. Fix it, or dispute it **per item** with `disputed: ` when the gate itself is wrong. - **"Foreign / infra reds (do not chase)"** — reds in files this PR does not touch. # gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

   pattern in `_sectionValidators` — delegate to the same public strict
   parser (`parseTuiSection`) instead of keeping a private mirror that
   has now drifted twice.

# gh-1636: [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console; should be debug-level / hidden by default

## Description

## Symptom
In an interactive session, when auto-compaction fires the console prints the full internal checkpoint summary (the structured notes the model uses to continue: goal, open asks, verified/assumed facts, hidden-segment index with ids, quoted prior user messages, etc.) plus markers like `● auto-compacted · structured·ckpt tokens: 105866 → 59496 (46370 freed · 44%)`. In a long session this appears several times and can be many screens of text, burying the actual assistant reply. The user reported it as "garbage output instead of your answer".

## Expected
This is debug/diagnostic information, not conversation. By default only a single short line (e.g. `auto-compacted: 105k → 59k tokens`) should be shown; the full summary should be hidden.

## Proposal
- Show only the one-line compaction marker by default.
- Gate the full checkpoint text behind a setting (e.g. `tui.showCompactionDetails: false` by default) and/or a debug log level / `/compaction` command to expand it on demand (the content stays in the session file and is reachable via `compact_expand`, so nothing is lost).
- Make sure the summary is never echoed into the visible assistant message stream in CLI/headless mode either.

## Notes
- No existing config key hides this (checked `config` keys; nothing under compaction/tui controls it).
- Related but different: #653 (stale "Auto-compacted" indicator), #286, #1425.
- Seen in fa 1.0.583 while working on a long session (many `ckpt` blocks and `hidden segments (compact_expand reopens any id)` lists printed inline).

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1741
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1741
- **Title**: gh-1636 [BUG] Auto-compaction dumps the full internal checkpoint summary into the user-visible console should be debug-level / hidden by default
- **Author**: ai-teammate
- **Branch**: `ai/gh-1636` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 17
- **Additions**: +451
- **Deletions**: -76
- **Created**: 2026-10-21T10:32:06Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-21T11:12:24Z

## PR Description

Closes #1636
### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Fixture repair the fix exposed: `agent_cli_over_window_windowed_resume_test` passed on a false positive — the answer turn was consumed as the post-run summary and matched the assertion only through the printed summary fence (the continuation itself crashed with an exhausted-script RangeError, at the base commit too). The script now carries explicit filler turns for every compaction-pipeline request, so the assertion verifies the real continuation answer.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

   pinned.

   pattern in `_sectionValidators` — delegate to the same public strict
   parser (`parseTuiSection`) instead of keeping a private mirror that
   has now drifted twice.

  if (value != null && value is! bool) {

}

Identical shape, differing only in the key name inside the message.

and call it for both, so the next `tui.*` boolean doesn't grow a third

   pattern in `_sectionValidators` — delegate to the same public strict
   parser (`parseTuiSection`) instead of keeping a private mirror that
   has now drifted twice.

The old mirror's theme check: `theme != null && '$theme'.trim().isEmpty` → error. parseTuiSection's: `theme is! String || trim empty` → error. # PR #1741 rework — gh-1636 review fixes

## Issues/Notes

All 3 open review threads are addressed; every fix is pushed on `ai/gh-1636`:

| Thread | Severity | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6uu82N` — stale `prompts.g.dart` | 🚨 BLOCKING | fixed — head `bcd9bfdb52` |
| `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6uu85b` — `tui` mirror rejects `statusLine` | ⚠️ IMPORTANT | fixed — head `98f4d437f9` |
| `PRRT_kwDOTXdlLc6uu88t` — twin bool validators | 💡 SUGGESTION | fixed — head `98f4d437f9` |

- No owned CI violations: `ci_failures.md` reports no failed checks at rework start (the red head the bot noticed, `6b6669060e`, is the pre-rework head; the blocking red it pointed at is exactly the stale-`prompts.g.dart` gate fixed here).

## Approach

1. **Stale generated prompt file (BLOCKING)** — ran `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart`: the regenerated `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` now embeds the new `### Compaction report detail` section of `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` into `builtinSkillFiles`, so the compiled-in `builtin://skills/self-settings/SKILL.md` carries the documented opt-in. Verified `gen_prompts.dart --check` exits 0 and `test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` is green (12/12).
2. **`tui` mirror drift (IMPORTANT)** — took the reviewer's option 2: deleted the private `_validateTuiSection` mirror in `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` and delegated the `tui:` entry in `_sectionValidators` to the same public strict parser boot uses, `parseTuiSection` (the established `power:`/`output:`/`subagents:` pattern). The parser's transitive closure is pure Dart (no `dart:io` — verified before importing), so the config service keeps backing every host. This ends the drift-prone mirror (it had already drifted twice: `classic`, then `statusLine`) and strictly raises service-side strictness to boot parity: `tui.statusLine: nerd` and unknown `statusLine:` keys now fail `fa config check`/`set` exactly as boot rejects them.
3. **Twin bool validators (SUGGESTION)** — extracted `bool _tuiBoolFlag(String key, Object? value)` in `lib/src/cli/tui_status_line.dart`; `parseTuiSection` calls it for `classic` and `showCompactionDetails`. Error messages are byte-identical to before.

TDD order per fix: reproduced first (`gen_prompts --check` exit 1 + `prompts_sync_test` red; new `check` test failing with the thread's exact `unknown tui key(s): statusLine` diagnostic), then the minimum change, then the suite.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/prompts/prompts.g.dart` — regenerated (1 line: the self-settings skill body now includes the compaction-detail section).
- `lib/src/config/config_service.dart` — `tui:` validator delegates to `parseTuiSection`; `_validateTuiSection` deleted.
- `lib/src/cli/tui_status_line.dart` — `_tuiClassicFlag`/`_tuiShowCompactionDetailsFlag` deduped into `_tuiBoolFlag`.
- `test/config/config_service_test.dart` — new `check` tests (`statusLine` accepted; bad shapes rejected like boot), extended `tui validation agrees with CliConfig.fromYaml` parity pin with `statusLine` cases.

Success = every thread has a targeted reply and the fixed code is pushed (when the threads require code changes). ## agent_task_preamble.md You are an agent triggered to perform a specific task. All required context — ticket description, PR diff, CI status, and related materials — has already been prepared in the `input/` folder. Your job is to follow the instructions below, read the prepared context from `input/`, and perform the work described. Do not ask for identifiers; the context is already available locally. ## coding_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD G1["⚠️ Coding Guidelines — follow existing codebase patterns and conventions"] G2["Before implementing, explore the project's code structure, architecture, and testing patterns"] G3["If AGENTS.md exists in project root or subdirectories → READ and FOLLOW it — it contains agent-specific instructions, coding styles, and conventions"] G4["If skills are available in the project → USE them — they provide specialized capabilities, workflows, and tool integrations"] G5["Instructions may be extended via project configuration — always follow the full set of provided instructions"] G6["Never invent new patterns when the codebase already has an established way of doing things"] G1 --> G2 --> G3 --> G4 --> G5 --> G6 ``` ## general_guidelines.md ```mermaid flowchart TD START([Ticket enters rework]) --> SETUP{rework_setup_failed.md exists?} SETUP -->|Yes| FAIL[Write setup failure response and stop] SETUP -->|No| INPUT[Read ALL input files in the ticket subfolder] INPUT --> INPUTS["request.md, comments.md, existing_questions.json, parent_context_*.md, pr_info.md, pr_diff.txt, merge_conflicts.md, ci_failures.md, ci_failures_full.log, review_state.md, pr_discussions.md, pr_discussions_raw.json"] INPUTS --> CONFLICTS{merge_conflicts.md exists?} CONFLICTS -->|Yes| RESOLVE["Resolve every conflict marker, git add each file, verify with git diff --check"] CONFLICTS -->|No| CI RESOLVE --> CI{ci_failures.md or ci_failures_full.log exists?} CI -->|Yes| OWNED{"Violations you must fix (N owned) table at the top?"} OWNED -->|Yes| FIX_OWNED["Fix EVERY owned violation (path:line, rule, measured vs limit)
— an owned violation may NOT be dismissed as unrelated/

Read ticket files to understand WHY it changed and verify the rework addresses all ACs. ## 2. Owned CI violations — no dismissal `ci_failures.md` opens with machine-extracted violation tables: - **"Violations you must fix (N owned)"** — each row (`check`, `rule`, `path:line`, measured-vs-limit) is in a file changed by this PR's diff. — do not expand scope beyond the reported issue"] T3["REFACTOR: Clean up while keeping tests GREEN
— run the full test suite after every change"] T4{"More findings to address?"} T5["Repeat RED-GREEN-REFACTOR for the next finding"] T0 --> T1 --> T2 --> T3 --> T4 T4 -->|Yes| T5 --> T1 T4 -->|No| DONE([All findings fixed with regression tests]) end subgraph RULES["PR Rework TDD Rules"] R1["❌ NEVER change production code in response to a review comment or CI failure without a test that first reproduces it"] R2["✅ If the existing tests only cover a single-item/simple case, add a test for the multi-item/edge case the finding points at — a fix without a test for that exact case is not verified"] R3["✅ Returned findings: your fix must differ from the previous attempt and the new/updated test must prove it"] R4["✅ Run the FULL test suite before finishing — no regressions allowed"] R5["✅ Verification order: finalize ALL fixes BEFORE launching the full test-suite/coverage run — a run over a tree you are still editing is wasted"] R6["✅ Long runs (full suite, coverage) start with bash background: true and are collected via bash_job status/output between other steps — NEVER foreground sleep-polling (see prompts/bash_tools.md)"] R7["❌ NEVER kill a running verification because files changed after it started — let it finish, treat the result as stale, re-run deliberately"] end TDD --> RULES ``` ## formatting_rules.md ```mermaid flowchart TD F1["outputs/response.md must be Markdown (# headings, - bullets, ``` code fences)"] F2["Required sections: ## Issues/Notes (if any), ## Approach, ## Files Modified, ## Test Coverage"] F3["Be surgical but thorough — fix exact issues flagged, then check same pattern across codebase"] F4["Do NOT refactor unrelated code or add unrequested features"] F5["When open PR review threads exist, create outputs/review_replies/*.md files and reference them from outputs/review_replies.json"] ``` - When `input//pr_discussions_raw.json` contains open PR review threads: - Write one Markdown file per open thread under `outputs/review_replies/`. - Write `outputs/review_replies.json` with one entry per open thread, including `inReplyToId`, `threadId`, and a `reply` field that contains the path to the matching `.md` file. -
